metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a long morning at the desk, the letter still open on the board, a bill for Wise Man you read on a Bishopsgate post, and a dozen leaves you stayed to read at Field's and brought home in the same fold.

yesterday: The letter to Anne is written and still open on the board. No one is named to carry it. You gave the coffer as nine pounds more than at New Year, and you left the box shut.

Mistress Ansell called the morning comedy because she heard the feet. She asked if the queen is punished, and she held her verdict until there is an ending. Alse asked once, about the jaw, and did not ask again. You missed supper.

You read Wise Man on a Bishopsgate post and walked home. You sat with the morning's leaf while the light went, and you left the paper under the queen's question blank. You looked at Gresham's plain tomb across the close and walked on.
Field laughed at the bellows-mender, and Jacqueline told you not to punish the queen. Field's chronicle stayed shut on your shelf. The pages came home in the same fold.
You told them you have not been paid. Gib was on the chronicle when you came in, and Alse put him on the Chaucer.
